description: This file defines a Unity MonoBehaviour script 'WaterBasic' that updates water shader parameters to create animated water effects by adjusting shader's wave offsets in the Unity game engine.

classes.name: WaterBasic
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour that updates water shader parameters each frame to animate water surface based on wave speed and scale.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Called every frame, retrieves the renderer and material, updates the wave offset based on elapsed time to animate water.
